_comment: Cam module library. id must equal the id= in the module's module.prop (the Manager matches installed modules by it); name, authors and summary follow module.prop too. repo is the GitHub repo whose releases carry the zip, asset a regex picking the zip from a release. scripts/gen_module_repo.py builds modules.json + module/<id>.json from this; .github/workflows/module-repo.yml publishes them to the module-repo branch (docs/CAM_CHANGES.md section 13).

modules.name: Magic Mount-rs
modules.summary: Metamodule that mounts modules with Magic Mount. Install one metamodule so module files show up in /system.

modules.name: Hybrid Mount
modules.summary: Metamodule mixing OverlayFS, Magic Mount and VFS to mount modules. Use it instead of Magic Mount-rs, not with it.

modules.name: Zygisk Next
modules.summary: Standalone implementation of Zygisk. Needed by Zygisk modules such as Vector and Play Integrity Fork. Pick either Zygisk Next or ReZygisk, not both.

modules.name: ReZygisk
modules.summary: Standalone implementation of Zygisk. Pick either ReZygisk or Zygisk Next, not both.

modules.name: Vector
modules.summary: Modern Xposed-compatible framework (successor of LSPosed), Android 8.1 to 17. Needs Zygisk.

modules.name: Play Integrity Fork
modules.summary: Fixes Play Integrity verdicts below Android 13 and Google Wallet/RCS on Android 7+. Needs Zygisk.

modules.name: bindhosts
modules.summary: Systemless hosts file for ad blocking, with a WebUI to manage sources.
